profiles.description: Word-centred vocabulary: every definition is a cited revision of one source

vocabulary.lexeme: a word of one language with its forms and senses, per source
vocabulary.definition revision: a definition as one source published it at one revision
vocabulary.languoid: a language, dialect or family identified by Glottocode

requires.reason: the bundle's own entry points use these operations
languages and lexemes resolve through reviewable identity
cross-language links, aliases, translations and search go through the existing multilingual records
identity and ISO code events are entity-history decisions
Wikidata, Glottolog, CLDR and ISO 639-3 sources run through the source-pack runtime
languoid points project into Geospatial places
etymological and typological references resolve to Science literature records

optional_features.description: Wiktionary entries from kaikki.org Wiktextract extracts: senses, definitions, forms, usage examples, structured etymologies and translation tables. Share-alike gated: every record and answer carries CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution and exports under another licence are refused.

requires.reason: the feature's records are lexicon records
the kaikki-wiktextract source runs through the source-pack runtime

optional_features.description: WALS feature values per languoid with their source references, and cited typological profiles; a feature without a value is 'no value on record'.

requires.reason: the feature's own entry points use these operations
WALS languages resolve through their published Glottocode
